name: worm-vue3-print
description: Vue 3 可视化打印模板设计器 + 表达式引擎 + 同构渲染管线（开源 monorepo）

scripts.publish:local: npm run build && npm -w @worm-vue3-print/core exec yalc push && npm -w @worm-vue3-print/canvas exec yalc push
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w @worm-vue3-print/core --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && npm publish -w @worm-vue3-print/canvas --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w @worm-vue3-print/core --dry-run --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && npm publish -w @worm-vue3-print/canvas --dry-run --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public
